_comment: Two caps for two different things. max_survivor_fraction is a one-sided cap on the SAMPLED run's survivor rate (saturable: below 1.0, because a rate in [0,1] can never exceed 1.0). unpinned_sites is the exact-count ratchet over the DETERMINISTIC inventory -- every candidate site the six operators generate across the whole tree -- and only moves down: a diff that adds a candidate site without a disposition raises it and is refused. A site carries a disposition under survivor_triage (a verdict) or killed_by (a driver that kills it). See the header of tests/mutation_table.py.

reason: The ratchet is the exact-count `unpinned_sites`: the deterministic inventory enumerates every candidate the six operators generate over the production package, and a site leaves that count only by carrying a disposition -- a `killed_by` driver, or a `survivor_triage` verdict (equivalent/gap) pinned to the exact `old` line. This record was re-derived at 467d3d9c on 2026-09-23 and moved 3785 -> 3781. The inventory stands at 3816 candidates, because the round-6 class fixes added 22 sites and removed 4 against the 3798 the previous record was written on. All 22 new sites now carry a disposition: 10 are killed by a recorded driver -- 6 by tests/finite_boundary.py (store.py:52, store.py:54, store.py:59, store.py:60, store.py:62, store.py:66; the store-load boundary of #1425) and 4 by tests/features.py (coordinator.py:10455, the adoption gate of #1410/#1437; sysid.py:585, sysid.py:723, sysid.py:740) -- 3 are triaged equivalent (store.py:50, a void mutant whose two arms are the same `return value`; sysid.py:726 and sysid.py:739, clamps whose `max` cannot select its second arm), and 9 are recorded as gap triage (store.py:64 and eight sysid.py sites no driver in the recorded net detects behaviourally). One property the 12 triage entries share, stated here so no reason hides it: tests/entities.py's #1217 mark-staleness self-check reddens when any `survivor_triage`-marked line is mutated, because the mark's pin then names a mutant the tree no longer generates. That is a property of the RECORD, not a behavioural kill -- the instrument's own D3-07 `equivalent` marks redden identically -- so these sites are survivors here and not `killed_by` entries, and a `killed_by` mark would not reproduce (entities.py reads `survivor_triage` only; moving a mark there yields entities.py rc=0, measured). The `gap` verdict is used here for the first time in this file's history: it records a MEASURED survivor, it is the honest disposition for one, and it does NOT move the fraction -- `survivor_gaps` counts every survivor no triage has called equivalent, so the sampled cap still reads these as gaps. Both caps and both `last_measured` blocks are unchanged. Do not raise `unpinned_sites` by hand: the exact count is re-derived every run by tests/mutation_table.py, which refuses growth and only records down via --record (and --record cannot fire on a branch whose diff puts no production file in scope, so this file was edited deliberately, with the measurement in the commit message).
